# Break

Source: [6001](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6001); edited 2025-05-23. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Break](../../api/actions/break.md).

<a id="wiki-6001-n1"></a>

- Break exits the current While or For loop to the first action after its End; it does not abort the whole rule.
